subject.title: fix(canvas): bound A2UI JSONL file reads

question: Should Canvas guarantee large A2UI input compatibility by checking the exact serialized Gateway request size, rather than publishing a fixed raw-file limit such as 20 MiB?
rationale: The Gateway limit applies to the JSON-serialized request frame, while valid JSONL has data-dependent escaping expansion; choosing a fixed product ceiling without that contract leaves accepted inputs that fail only at transport time.

options.title: Budget the emitted frame
options.body: Require a preflight based on the actual serialized `node.invoke` frame or a proven worst-case bound, then prove an escaped large payload reaches a paired node.

options.title: Keep a smaller raw ceiling
options.body: Choose and document a conservative raw limit that is safe for worst-case JSON escaping, accepting that it reduces large-payload capacity.

options.title: Pause the increase
options.body: Retain the prior compatible limit until Canvas and Gateway owners agree on a transport-aware payload contract.

recommendation.title: Budget the emitted frame
recommendation.body: Require a preflight based on the actual serialized `node.invoke` frame or a proven worst-case bound, then prove an escaped large payload reaches a paired node.

likelyOwner.reason: Their current-head change specifically adjusts the Canvas-to-Gateway payload budget.
